about_the_game:
Step into a mesmerizing maze where every tilt, every turn, and every decision sets your pulse racing. In Orbital Descent, you command a rolling ball through a dynamic labyrinth using simple controls of W, A, S, D to tilt the maze and the arrow keys to adjust your view, challenging your reflexes and precision at every twist.

The maze rotates beneath your ball, revealing dangerous corridors, hidden coin caches, and secret shortcuts designed for the ultimate speedrun. Here’s where it gets interesting: you can race through the course with perfectly timed skips to smash records, or you can take the scenic route... collecting every coin to achieve 100% completion. Every run is a tactical decision; do you risk it all for speed, or do you meticulously gather every collectible for the full experience?

Every tilt is a strategic choice, and every misstep teaches you the intricate dance of angles and timing required to master this relentless challenge. Orbital Descent offers a dual path to victory, whether you're chasing the thrill of a flawless, lightning-fast run or savoring the satisfaction of complete mastery.

Dive into Orbital Descent, where your skill, persistence, and strategy determine whether you’re a speedrunner at heart or a completionist who leaves no coin unturned. The maze awaits - choose your path and show the world what you’re made of!
